value.rationale: The full tetrahedral symmetry of a canonical Archimedean graph acts on a natural topological invariant: the matching-complex homology. A complete 22-dimensional rational character identifies exactly four nontrivial Specht types and a one-dimensional A4-fixed subspace while proving the full S4 fixed subspace vanishes. Neither this decomposition nor those symmetry-fixed dimensions can be inferred from the previously known ordinary homotopy rank, and both specify natural structurally meaningful questions.
